news.summary: The EU and Britain on Tuesday signed a deal ending border checks between Gibraltar and Spain six years after the UK left the bloc. Gibraltar residents can now cross to Spain using ‌residence cards ​while Spanish citizens can cross using a government ID card.

news.headline: Diamond giant De Beers halts work at flagship South African mine as demand plummets
news.summary: Production will stop for two years at the mine which employs more than 4,000 people.
